mechanism: Isocarboxazid is a non-selective monoamine oxidase inhibitor that can potentiate serotonergic effects; lansoprazole may have weak serotonergic properties and both agents can inhibit gastric acid production affecting drug absorption and increasing GI bleeding risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use with extreme caution and monitor closely for serotonin syndrome symptoms and GI bleeding; ensure adequate washout period if switching medications.
